en: We're here in Hopedale, Massachusetts, in the US,
to see how this Império line door turned out,
When we installed it: minus 14 Celsius, snow everywhere, all white.
With Rafael from Fast Shapes, checking it out.
The homeowner chose a recessed pull handle with LED lighting, and an electronic handle,
Another Doormaxx exclusive: this handle, minimalist and beautiful, with an LED presence sensor as you approach, plus the latest unlocking technology.
If you live in the US, it's available now.
Contact Fast Shapes, and we'll take care of you with Alucomaxx and DoorMaxx tech.
